domains.name: Redis Client Infrastructure
domains.description: Core abstraction layer and implementations for Redis connectivity using Jedis and Lettuce clients. Defines the IRedisClient interface contract for all Redis operations (hash, string, scan, queue) and provides multiple concrete implementations with connection pooling. Includes the RedisClientManager factory for managing client instances across production and test environments.

domains.name: Redis Configuration Management
domains.description: Configuration properties classes that define connection parameters (host, port, password) for different Redis instances. Each properties class corresponds to a specific Redis deployment: main production, test, Shiro authentication, Special PM (old and new servers), Marriott quote cluster, and BookingPal quote. Enables environment-specific configuration for multi-Redis architecture.

domains.name: Quote Caching Clients
domains.description: Specialized Redis client implementations for channel-specific quote caching. Includes MrtQuoteLettuceClusterClient for Marriott (MRT) using Lettuce cluster mode, BpQuoteLettuceClient for BookingPal (BP) quotes using Lettuce with SSL, and SpecialPmClient for Special PM operations with separate old/new server configurations. These clients are selected by channel abbreviation in RedisClientManager.

domains.name: Authentication Cache
domains.description: Dedicated Redis client and utilities for Shiro-based authentication caching. ShiroJedisClient extends JedisClient with separate connection pool using ShiroProperties configuration. Works in conjunction with RedisAccessTokenUtils for managing access tokens in Redis for user session management.

domains.name: Redis Data Types and Utilities
domains.description: Supporting data structures and utility classes for Redis operations. Includes AccessTokenDto for token data transfer, RedisKey for key definition patterns, RedisCacheException for standardized error handling, and RedisObjectSerializer for object serialization when storing complex objects in Redis.
